text:
alex_ae: FYI — Marlin wants a quick perf POC next week. They want to validate 250 QPS sustained with occasional 2k QPS spikes, 512 token avg prompts. Need a load plan + rough cost estimate. Can we run hosted smoke first? :eyes:

samir_se: Sounds doable. Quick Qs: model family (open vs ff), expected response length, sync or streaming responses? Also any PCI/data residency constraints?

alex_ae: They prefer open Llama-like models, response avg ~150 tokens. Streaming OK but not required. For POC they can accept hosted infra under NDA, longterm they need Private/VPC. No PCI on POC.

priya_sre: For 250 sustained qps with 150 token responses you'll likely need X GPUs on hosted. Suggest plan:
- smoke (5m): 50 qps single AZ
- ramp (15m): 50 -> 250 qps steady
- spike test (10m): 250 -> 2k qps short bursts (Poisson arrivals)
- soak (30m): maintain 250 qps to check memory leak/KV cache
Include KV cache warmup and prefix caching.

maria_sales: Price angle — give them two estimates: hosted variable (per-token) and Dedicated reserved (monthly) with ballpark SLA. Also call out potential cost delta if we enable prefix caching / quantized model.

jeff_infra: If we do spike to 2k qps we should enable autoscale burst nodes and a fallback model (smaller quantized) for tail handling. Opsbot will create a run ID.

opsbot: Benchmark run scheduled: run_id=marlin-2024-06-12-09, owner=alex_ae, infra=hosted, plan=ramp+spike+soak

samir_se: Example load command we'll run from k6 controller:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m script.js --out influxdb=...
```
script will vary prompt length and insert jitter.

priya_sre: Quick cost sketch (hosted): ~0.000035 $/prompt-token + 0.00002 $/response-token (ballpark) -> at 250 qps * 150 resp tokens ~ 32k tokens/s -> ~$1.12k/hr. With caching this drops ~30-40%. Dedicated monthly quote will be much lower at scale.

alex_ae: Can we surface latency SLOs? Marlin cares about p95 < 300ms for small prompts, but p95 up to 900ms acceptable for longer ones.

jeff_infra: We'll capture p50/p95/p99. Initial host run numbers (dry run earlier) looked like:
```
qps: 250
latency p50: 130ms
latency p95: 410ms
latency p99: 980ms
errors: 0.1% (mostly timeouts at peak)
```
Need smaller model variant fallback to keep p99 < 800ms for spike windows.

maria_sales: I'll prepare two slides: cost comparison and SLA tradeoffs, and include a note about security questionnaire — they asked about KMS and audit logs. For POC we can show audit logs in Console.

samir_se: Action items:
- samir_se: prepare k6 scripts + config for variable arrival rates
- priya_sre: provision burst nodes and configure fallback model + caching
- jeff_infra: run dry-run and attach raw csvs
- maria_sales: draft pricing slide and short runbook for customer ops
- alex_ae: confirm NDA and sign-off to run hosted POC

alex_ae: will confirm NDA today. target to start run Tue 09:00 PT. Thanks all :rocket:
